title: Rapid 1:1 — AE/CSM/SE alignment (pre-meeting & follow-up)
one_liner: 15-minute standing sync to triage top account risk, unblock technical work, and agree clear next steps for the week.
agenda: 1) 2 min - Quick status: win / risk / blocker (each person one sentence)
2) 6 min - Top 3 accounts to triage (MRR impact + health signal)
3) 4 min - Technical unblock & SE asks (deploys, logs, KMS, private VPC)
4) 3 min - Actions, owners, deadlines, and follow-up cadence
metric_snapshot: Weekly MRR coverage in active pipeline: $1.2M (expansion-heavy)
Renewals next 60 days: 4 accounts, combined ARR $420k
Average time to first response this week: 1.6h
notes: Quick context: focusing on three accounts where Dedicated/Private rollout timelines slipped due to infra permissions and KMS integration.
Customer A (FinTech) - renewal likely but flagged for security review; SE to confirm HSM roadmap and Redwood Private template.
Customer B (SaaS) - expansion opportunity tied to Optimize recommendations; AE to share proof-of-savings calc by Friday.
Customer C (Marketplaces) - latency regression after quantized model switch; investigating kernel selection mismatch on Ampere nodes.
Internal dependencies: infra access for SE (vault creds), product sign-off on fallback routing policy for dedicated pools, legal for updated DPA clause for HSM.
Tone: keep brief, decide 1-2 high-leverage actions (avoid long brainstorming in this slot).
open_questions: What is the customer-facing timeline we can commit to for KMS/HSM integration? (Product + Security)
Can we provide a short-run cost vs quality table for non-quantized vs 4-bit quantized models for Customer B? (Research)
Do we have a Canary plan for fallback routing that avoids visible downtime? (SRE + Serving Runtime)
Any legal blockers to pushing updated DPA to these customers this quarter?
action_items: A1 - Liam Chen: Draft KMS integration note for Customer A (include HSM options + estimated ETA). Due: 2026-03-12.
A2 - Noah Patel (owner): Build simple cost-savings slide for Customer B using Redwood Optimize baseline vs proposed config. Due: 2026-03-13.
A3 - Ava Martinez: Open SR with Infra to escalate the kernel/driver mismatch for latency regression on Customer C, reference ticket RED-3376. Due: 2026-03-11.
A4 - AE/CSM: Confirm with procurement whether expansion PO process can be started while security review is ongoing. Owner: Maya (AE). Due: 2026-03-15.
A5 - SE: Prepare a 10-line runbook for canary fallback (steps + rollback). Owner: Liam. Due: 2026-03-12.
A6 - Noah: Schedule 30m follow-up with Product + Security if KMS ETA > 2 weeks. Due: 2026-03-14.
followup_plan: After this sync: send a concise summary to stakeholders (CS + AE + SE + Product + Infra). Re-share edited playbook page on Confluence and attach the cost slide. If any item is blocked >48h, escalate in #cs-ops channel and tag leads.
meeting_prep_tips: Bring one single ask for the group — e.g., a decision, a blocking resource, or a customer commitment.
If presenting numbers, include assumptions (sequence length, token mix, expected concurrency). Keep it 2 slides max.
Use Jira ticket keys in conversation to speed engineering triage (link tickets in live doc).
rapid-checklist: Have the latest logs (S3 link) and a short sample prompt that reproduces the regression.
Confirm PTO coverage for any owners with upcoming time off.
Ensure legal has the DPA draft linked if renewal discussions start.
